title: Enshrouded – ruhige Detailansicht
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a NEW complete design sheet for the small private Sturmklingen family game-server app. Image 1 is the USER-APPROVED updated dashboard STYLE and must determine the quiet design language: flat charcoal background, simple dark surfaces, fine subdued separators, ivory readable text, clean sans-serif controls and headings, restrained warm gold only for small STURMKLINGEN wordmark and primary action. Small sword mark in the masthead. No ornate fantasy frames, gold bevels, stone dungeon/fire scenery, corner decorations, oversized serif headings, diamond dividers, nested panels, giant icons, blue SaaS styling or new features.
Flat DESKTOP-left and MOBILE-right design sheet, BOTH screens complete and readable, landscape ideally 2048x1536, no device hardware/perspective, no cropping, no tiny text. Same functions and exact German copy in both viewports. Status and actions are the primary visual focus, with generous clear spacing and comfortable touch targets. All data are fictional concepts. Real app UI will later be HTML, not a screenshot. No actual IP, secrets, invented codes, metrics, player counts, logs, lore, unrelated admin features, badges, subtitles or watermark.
SCREEN: Enshrouded details, family view. Images 2 and 3 are its REAL original logo and actual game key art; use these faithfully. Do not invent a generic castle landscape or replace the distinctive white/cyan Enshrouded logo with plain text. A compact branded banner (real cool teal/green waterfall, three adventurers and recognisable logo) establishes immediate game identity; preserve original artwork colours, make banner much shallower than on the dashboard. No artwork under the action region.
Masthead STURMKLINGEN, back link Serverzentrale. No Zugänge link in this family view. The game logo is the page identity; do not repeat an immense generic title. Then quiet plain status region with exact lines 'Server läuft' and 'Spielbereitschaft unbekannt' (a running process is not a readiness confirmation). Small process marker, neutral separate readiness line. Buttons 'Starten' disabled matte gray, 'Stoppen' enabled dark secondary with an ivory label. Status/actions are clearly visible immediately below the short banner.
Then section heading 'Beitreten', field label 'Beitrittsadresse', value 'Noch nicht verfügbar', button 'Kopieren' clearly disabled. Never invent an address. Desktop join value and copy button can share a row; mobile stack them. No large scene or giant heading consumes the screen. All information in BOTH viewports.

title: Zustände – ruhige Hinweise
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a NEW complete design sheet for the small private Sturmklingen family game-server app. Image 1 is the USER-APPROVED updated dashboard STYLE and must determine the quiet design language: flat charcoal background, simple dark surfaces, fine subdued separators, ivory readable text, clean sans-serif controls and headings, restrained warm gold only for small STURMKLINGEN wordmark and primary action. Small sword mark in the masthead. No ornate fantasy frames, gold bevels, stone dungeon/fire scenery, corner decorations, oversized serif headings, diamond dividers, nested panels, giant icons, blue SaaS styling or new features.
Flat DESKTOP-left and MOBILE-right design sheet, BOTH screens complete and readable, landscape ideally 2048x1536, no device hardware/perspective, no cropping, no tiny text. Same functions and exact German copy in both viewports. Status and actions are the primary visual focus, with generous clear spacing and comfortable touch targets. All data are fictional concepts. Real app UI will later be HTML, not a screenshot. No actual IP, secrets, invented codes, metrics, player counts, logs, lore, unrelated admin features, badges, subtitles or watermark.
SCREEN: a large readable component/state reference sheet in 2x2 arrangement, NOT four full dashboards. Same flat quiet charcoal design and sans-serif hierarchy. No scenic art and no giant decorative icons/serif headers. Small meaningful status indicators at most. No gold frames, diamonds or panels inside panels. Four separate states:
TOP LEFT heading 'Enshrouded'; exact status 'Start läuft …'; helper 'Der Start wird geprüft.'. Small loading mark, BOTH buttons 'Starten' and 'Stoppen' visibly disabled matte gray, no success/ready claim.
TOP RIGHT heading 'Enshrouded'; exact status 'Ausgang unklar'; helper 'Der Ausgang der Aktion ist noch nicht bestätigt.'. Both 'Starten' and 'Stoppen' disabled; one enabled quiet secondary 'Status prüfen'. Small subdued amber caution mark. No retry control and no automatic repeat.
BOTTOM LEFT heading 'ASKA'; exact status 'Start fehlgeschlagen'; helper 'Server gestoppt'. 'Starten' enabled muted-gold primary, 'Stoppen' disabled matte gray. This state represents a confirmed failure AND separately confirmed stopped server, not merely a timeout. No green success or readiness.
BOTTOM RIGHT a standalone full-page access-denied component, exact heading 'Zugriff gesperrt', exact body 'Bitte wende dich an die Verwaltung.'. No game details, controls, admin link or extra navigation. A small understated lock icon is optional, never dominant.
All text crisp and roomy. These examples must look like operational UI components from the approved dashboard, no poster aesthetic.
